comparison.objective: Sharpen both sides of a knife at controlled angles; candidate performs connector rework.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained angled sliding contact over a stone versus constrained blade insertion around a contact and latch-release force control.
comparison.success_condition: Requires qualifying strokes on both sides and safe final knife placement; candidate requires selective terminal extraction without damage. Candidate damage limits lack numeric thresholds.
comparison.reason: Shared contact control is generic; the tested mechanisms and outcomes are unrelated.
